goal.description: What you have to do to finish your slot. Press the matching 'Goal' button in the Manual client when you do it.

include_galaxy_unlocks.description: A check is sent every time you unlock a new galaxy (Sky Station Galaxy is open from the start, so it has none).

include_prankster_comet_stars.description: Include the Power Stars that only appear while a Prankster Comet is orbiting the galaxy (speed runs, daredevil runs, purple coin runs...).

include_mailtoad_letter_stars.description: Include the Power Stars that only appear after the Mailtoad delivers a letter (The Chimp's challenges, C'mere Goomba/Topman, Jungle Fluzzard Race, Fastest Feathers in the Galaxy).

include_green_stars.description: Include the 120 Green Stars (needs the 120 Power Stars first). Forced on when the goal needs them.

include_grandmaster_galaxy.description: Include the Grandmaster Galaxy checks (needs all 240 Power + Green Stars). Forced on when the goal is the Grandmaster Galaxy.
